svg.title: MACHINA MUNDI — brass clockwork orrery
svg.desc: Eight worlds on a brass plate, orbited at their true relative periods, driven by a visibly meshing toothed train; a day and night shadow sweeps across each globe.

g.text: A BRASS ORRERY · TRUE RELATIVE PERIODS · EARTH YEAR = 12 SECONDS OF BRASS
SEVEN MESHS, EIGHT ARBORS · ONE TURN OF THE MASTER ARBOR = ONE TERRAEAN YEAR
MODULE m = 7 · PITCH CIRCLE TANGENT AT EVERY MESH
ORBITAL PERIODS: EXACT. SPIN: COMPRESSED AS √(DAY), SIGN PRESERVED — TRUE DAYS WOULD BLUR TO A HUM; VENVS AND VRANVS TURN BACKWARDS.
THE SHADOW NEVER TURNS: IT WAITS ANTI-SOLAR WHILE THE GLOBE CARRIES ITS LANDS THROUGH IT. EYES RIGHT — NEPTVNE IS MOVING.
RE-CUT A WHEEL: SET THE MASTER ARBOR TO 300s TO MAKE EARTH A MINUTE LONG, AND THE HEAVENS WILL STILL BE TRUE IN PROPORTION.
